forbid.message:
Raw

decides the type scale a second time. Render copy through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (, or MutedText for secondary copy) so the catalog owns the scale.
Raw <span> decides the type scale a second time. Render copy through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="span">, or MutedText for secondary copy) so the catalog owns the scale.
Raw <h1> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h1" variant="h1">), or through PageHeader for a page title.
Raw <h2> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h2" variant="h2">), or through the Card and Section headings that already wrap it.
Raw <h3> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h3" variant="h3">), or through the Card and Section headings that already wrap it.
Raw <h4> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h4" variant="h4">), or through the Card and Section headings that already wrap it.
Raw <h5> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h5">), or through the Card and Section headings that already wrap it.
Raw <h6> decides the type scale a second time. Render headings through Text from @bc-solutions-coder/ui (<Text as="h6">), or through the Card and Section headings that already wrap it.
